description: This file defines a mock database class for notification style demo data, including several nested data classes for different notification styles such as BigTextStyle, BigPictureStyle, InboxStyle, and MessagingStyle. It provides singleton accessors and sample data for testing or demonstration purposes.

classes.name: MockDatabase
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve sample notification style data instances.

classes.name: BigTextStyleReminderAppData
classes.description: A singleton data class representing information for BigTextStyle notifications, with preset content titles, texts, and a toString override.

classes.name: BigPictureStyleSocialAppData
classes.description: A singleton data class representing information for BigPictureStyle notifications, including image references, participant lists, responses, and descriptive texts.

classes.name: InboxStyleEmailAppData
classes.description: A singleton data class encapsulating email notification info such as email summaries, counts, and participant lists.

classes.name: MessagingStyleCommsAppData
classes.description: A singleton data class for messaging notifications, including message histories, participant info, and conversation summaries.

methods.name: getBigTextStyleData
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BigTextStyleReminderAppData.

methods.name: getBigPictureStyleData
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BigPictureStyleSocialAppData.

methods.name: getInboxStyleData
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of InboxStyleEmailAppData.

methods.name: getMessagingStyleData
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessagingStyleCommsAppData.
